meta.title: An amendment copies the technical round and one price round, never lot rounds
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The available setup recipes and operations cannot create or read a lot round, so exclusion of lot rounds is not checked.
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The available vocabulary cannot create the second event raised from a PR or perform a separate amendment for that event.

The available read-backs cannot verify that the copied technical round is the last live one, that the auction is preferred as the latest non-lot price round, or that an RFQ is preferred for a PR amendment.
The available tokens do not expose the amended draft's new round identifiers, so the round reads use the source event's round identifiers.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
The buyer issues a new version of the event.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals draft; Schema check: “stages” is not empty.
As the buyer, read the technical round and check that Schema check: “title” is present; Schema check: “rfx mode” is present.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Schema check: “title” is present; Schema check: “rfx mode” is present.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals draft; Schema check: “stages” is not empty; Schema check: “title” is present; Schema check: “rfx mode” is present; Schema check: “title” is present; Schema check: “rfx mode” is present.
